_description: Adversarial prompts for eval/redteam_guardrail.py. 'covered' phrasings closely match the patterns already in src/guardrails.py (sanity check, should block). 'obfuscated' are variations on those same techniques, designed to test whether small changes in phrasing slip past a regex. 'novel' are injection techniques the regex was never written to catch. 'benign' are real support questions that happen to use guardrail-adjacent words, to check the screen doesn't fire on legitimate traffic.
